title: 131m Mountain Gate That Jets Have Flown Through | China Travel Expert
description:
On Tianmen Mountain in Hunan there's a hole punched clean through the rock — a natural arch 131.5 metres tall called Heaven's Gate. It's so big that stunt pilots have flown planes straight through it, in 1999 and again in 2006.

To reach it on foot you climb 999 steps up the mountainside (locals call them the Stairway to Heaven). The arch wasn't carved — historical records say the cave roof collapsed in 263 AD and left this vast opening in the cliff. Take the cable car most of the way, then do the steps for the view back down through the gate.

🧭 Expert Tip: ride the cable car up and save your legs for the 999 steps — that final climb to the arch is the part worth doing on foot.

湖南天门山的“天门洞”是一个高 131.5 米的天然山洞，特技飞行员曾驾机穿洞而过；上去要爬 999 级台阶。
